subject: Rossilini
author: Legend Supercar
body:
Rossilini Darkshooter

 

Known as the ultimate Racecar, The darkshooter was(and still is) the racer to beat thanks to the favouritism of Burnout fans and Professionals alike Including umopapisdnpuag and WELI3R.

 

That means it has a restored and reworked 6.3 Litre V10 Complete with 2 Turbochargers which means a total Power Output of 785 BHP. That also means a 0-60 time of 3 seconds flat and a max speed of 248MPH.

subject: Speed cars
author: Wei
body:
I would have to go with either the Bugatti Veyron:

Or the Shelby Super Car (SSC) Ultimate Aero TT:

People still debate on which is actually the fastest.  The Guiness Book of Records says that the SSC is the fastest, but test drivers for the Veyron have insisted that the Bugatti could be faster if they were more willing to push the speed.  The official difference between them is 2.37 mph (3.81 kph).

With them that close, they would have to be stats something like:
